glosses: To act or proceed slowly or without enthusiasm; to be reluctant.

examples.text: Dragging yourself out of a warm bed in the early hours of a wintry morning to go for a hike in the woods: It’s not an easy thing for some to do, but the visual treasures that await could be well worth the effort. examples.text: A propeller is said to drag when the sails urge the vessel faster than the revolutions of the screw can propel her.
